description: We are a team of motivated students participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Our interests include space exploration, technology, science, and problem-solving. We are excited to learn, collaborate, research, and develop an innovative solution. We welcome passionate teammates with skills in coding, software development, graphic design, data analysis, and science. Beginners are welcome!
summary:
**ADM Space Innovators – AI-Powered Earth Intelligence Platform**

ADM Space Innovators is an innovative web-based platform designed to transform NASA Earth observation data into meaningful environmental insights. Our project aims to help people understand important challenges such as climate change, air pollution, deforestation, floods, droughts, and environmental degradation.

The platform provides an interactive dashboard for exploring Earth-related information through maps, data visualizations, and environmental indicators. It aims to integrate NASA satellite and Earth science datasets with AI-powered analysis to make complex scientific information easier to understand.

Our mission is to make space technology and Earth science accessible to students, researchers, environmental organizations, and communities. By turning satellite observations into understandable insights, ADM Space Innovators supports environmental awareness and informed decision-making.

**Our vision is simple: Turning NASA Data into Earth Intelligence for a better and more sustainable future.**

ADM Space Innovators – Project Demonstration

Welcome to ADM Space Innovators, an AI-Powered Earth Intelligence Platform.

In this demonstration, we introduce our platform, which aims to transform NASA Earth observation data into useful environmental insights.

1. Homepage
Our homepage introduces the platform, its mission, and its goal of making Earth science accessible to everyone.

2. Earth Intelligence Dashboard
The dashboard presents environmental information through interactive visualizations and data indicators.

3. NASA Data Exploration
Users can explore Earth observation information to understand environmental changes and challenges.

4. Environmental Analysis
Our platform focuses on important environmental challenges, including climate change, air pollution, deforestation, floods, and droughts.

5. Our Impact
ADM Space Innovators aims to help students, researchers, and communities understand environmental challenges and make informed decisions.

Our Vision: Turning NASA Data into Earth Intelligence for a better and more sustainable future.

Thank you for exploring ADM Space Innovators!
